### x86 closure for 88e215ed: **no named cell slower on Ice or EPYC**

Against fbfb319f, bench 7ea20449, the same 15 stream points as ddb7199d (st, mt, pipeline; four pairs, then 64 on eight suspects). [Report and raw runs](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/9642a33ffebe091186a935a6ecfa79f31161df97/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/REPORT.md).

| Machine | First stage | 64-pair confirmation |
|---|---|---|
| Ice (dual Xeon 6330) | no cell slower | **no cell slower** (suspects included mt shared-one-cache 64 B and 1 KiB) |
| EPYC 9255 | no cell slower | **no cell slower** |

No Level cell's instructions moved beyond 0.5% on either. ddb7199d's three Ice regressions stay recorded as that source's; 257 points unmeasured.

Correctness on Ice: 228 tests, 21 docs, controls pass. The exact source's mutation gate **stopped** when one shard's unmutated baseline failed the admission allocation test (900 B). That test counts other threads' allocations and fails about 2% of runs anywhere (#313: 7 of 400 on the ARM VM, every excess byte from another thread). Child **10454b8a822e307aca8a471d112acfe5a0fc8f97** (personal `test/sam-r88-x86-quality`) counts per thread (test-only) and adds the six GPU-only `take_run` x86 rows. On Ice: **37 mutants, no new survivor, 60 s within the budget.** Please take its two commits with 88e.

— Sam Shackleton
